notes: side_px is how far the feet stand outside the footprint edge, or from the base center when measure is center. contact_px is how far the tool, hand, or spout reaches from the feet along facing. y_px shifts the ground line. overrides may replace any field for one station id. actors.<id> replaces fields for that hero. force_side skips the nearest-side pick. Wood is always the east stand (right of the trunk, facing west, W axe clip). Manatree is one west stand for every growth stage. The door sill is the node origin. The pour ends 5px above the feet, so y_px 13 puts that end 8px south of the sill, on the soil just in front of the trunk. No per-stage offset.
